subject: Approve request: SDE3 replacement (attrition) — proposed band, sign-on, headcount
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approve request: SDE3 replacement (attrition) — proposed band, sign-on, headcount

Team,

Quick context: Rachel P. left the SRE team effective 9/10 (attrition). This role is critical for the infra reliability work queued in Q4. Recruiting has an active external candidate (Jordan A.) at the final stage and we also have an internal transfer candidate option (Marcus L.) but Marcus would create a different downstream gap in Analytics.

Ask: approve one headcount refill at SDE3 level and sign-off on the compensation structure below so we can issue an offer by EOD Wednesday:
- Base band: $170k–$195k (target midpoint $182k)
- Equity: 0.08%–0.12% (4yr, 1yr cliff)
- Target total comp at midpoint: ~ $195–205k
- One-time sign-on: $15k (market competitive; internal transfer sign-on negotiable)

Attachments: comp_band_matrix_q3_2026.xlsx (band mapping) and offer_template_engineering_v2.pdf (draft).

If approved, Neha will route the offer and I’ll attach the finance/headcount tag. If we prefer internal transfer instead of external, note that Marcus requires a release from his manager by 9/16 and we'd need quick cross-team coordination.

Please reply with explicit approval or changes.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of SWE, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

[attachment: comp_band_matrix_q3_2026.xlsx] [attachment: offer_template_engineering_v2.pdf]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, TalentOps <talentops@hirelane.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approve request: SDE3 replacement (attrition) — proposed band, sign-on, headcount

Karthik —
Thanks for the clear ask. Quick update from recruiting: Jordan A. (external) completed loop last week; compensation expectation is $185k base, asking $20k sign-on due to counteroffer from current employer. Marcus L. (internal) is at IC3+ and manager is open to transfer but needs a formal backfill request from Analytics if we pull him.

Recommendation: Extend to Jordan at $182k base, $15k sign-on, equity 0.10% — this keeps us inside the band, meets candidate expectations, and avoids internal churn. If finance pushes back on sign-on, we can lower to $10k but risk losing Jordan (he has a tight window).

I’ve attached the pre-filled offer doc. If you approve today, I’ll kick off DocuSign and copy Amanda Lee from our TA vendor for service-level approval.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Recruiter, Technical Hiring
Redwood Inference

[attachment: offer_template_engineering_v2.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approve request: SDE3 replacement (attrition) — proposed band, sign-on, headcount

Karthik / Neha —
I support the external hire plan for Jordan at the recommended structure: $182k base / $15k sign-on / 0.10% equity. We need someone ramped fast for the Q4 reliability milestones — Jordan’s background checks out and he has relevant infra experience.

If Marcus ends up being the selected internal transfer, I’ll coordinate with Analytics to confirm replacement timing. But my preference is to accept the external candidate to avoid cross-org churn.

Approved from Eng (Laura).

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Systems Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approve request: SDE3 replacement (attrition) — proposed band, sign-on, headcount

Thanks — flagging finance / budget considerations: the org has one uncommitted headcount in Q4 that can be used for this refill. We will approve the headcount provided TA tags the hire to cost center 2-Infra-Prod and the sign-on is coded as a one-time hiring expense. I’m fine with $15k sign-on as long as total expected initial Opex impact is submitted to payroll (I need the final offer terms before we trigger the payment).

Please add Amanda Lee (vendor TA) as a signer on the DocuSign and paste the payroll code in the final offer email.

-S.N.
Stephanie Nguyen
Finance Partner, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan A. <jordan.a@example.com>, TalentOps <talentops@hirelane.com>, Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@redwoodpartner.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approve request: SDE3 replacement (attrition) — proposed band, sign-on, headcount

Approved — proceeding with external offer to Jordan per terms: $182k base / $15k sign-on / 0.10% equity; cost center 2-Infra-Prod. Neha, please send DocuSign using the attached template and include payroll code: PR-ENG-2026-Q4-02. Amanda, please confirm vendor acceptance on your side once DocuSign is routed.

Jordan — welcome! We’ll send a formal offer now; please review and sign within 48 hours if you want the 9/27 start window we discussed.

Next steps:
- Neha: route DocuSign + final offer (attachment: docusign-offer-link.txt)
- Stephanie: finalize payroll booking after sign-off
- Laura: prepare onboarding plan for week 1

Karthik
Head of SWE, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

[attachment: docusign-offer-link.txt]
